description:
The leading WebAssembly Runtime supporting WASI and Emscripten

Wasmer is a fast and secure WebAssembly runtime that enables super lightweight containers to run anywhere: from Desktop to the Cloud, Edge and IoT devices.
This release includes:
- A WASIX import preparation hook.
- General N-API improvements, including guest heap growth through the store.
- A maximum output-size budget for Singlepass.
- An updated static MemoryStyle API, now requiring an 8 GiB memory mapping.
Added
- #6960 Add a WASIX import preparation hook
- #6927 CI: add dependency cooldown CI job (3 days)
Changed
- #6887 feat(api): let host code lend the executing store
- #6888 feat(napi): grow the guest heap through the store
- #6953 deps(chacha20): update to not yanked version
- #6934 tests: sync latest WebAssembly spec tests
- #6923 feat!: drop legacy create-exe code
- #6932 CI: use LLVM ZST tarballs
- #6908 feat(Singlepass)(V2): introduce max_output_size budget system
- #6929 CI: skip 2 tests on macOS
- #6925 feat(nix): provide shell completions
- #6924 docs: Singlepass supports multi-value experimentally
- #6921 feat(MemoryStyle::static): adjust API and require mmap of 8GiB (#13)
- #6917 deps: update wasm-tools related crates
- #6920 deps: bump cranelift to 0.135
- #6919 script: rework release-related scripts
Fixed
- #6965 fix(LLVM): use correct BBs as PHI inputs in call_indirect
- #6886 fix(api): give each call its own store context entry
- #6922 fix(nix): install C header from Cargo artifacts
